import pandas as pd

# Load the selected matrix
selected_matrix = pd.read_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv')

# Median imputation
selected_matrix.fillna(selected_matrix.median(), inplace=True)

# Standard scaling
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled_matrix = scaler.fit_transform(selected_matrix)

# KMeans clustering
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled_matrix)

# Create a DataFrame with the city-year rows and their cluster labels
city_clusters = pd.DataFrame({
    'city_id': selected_matrix['city_id'],
    'city_name': selected_matrix['city_name'],
    'year': selected_matrix['year'],
    'cluster_id': cluster_labels
})

# Write the city-cluster assignments to a CSV file
city_clusters.to_csv('outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv', index=False, quotechar='"')

# Compute the mean of the raw indicator values for each cluster
cluster_profiles = pd.DataFrame({
    'cluster_id': kmeans.labels_,
    'indicator1': [selected_matrix[selected_matrix['cluster_id'] == i]['indicator1'].mean() for i in range(3)],
    'indicator2': [selected_matrix[selected_matrix['cluster_id'] == i]['indicator2'].mean() for i in range(3)],
    'indicator3': [selected_matrix[selected_matrix['cluster_id'] == i]['indicator3'].mean() for i in range(3)]
})

# Write the cluster profiles to a CSV file
cluster_profiles.to_csv('outputs/t13_cluster_profiles.csv', index=False, quotechar='"')
</solution_file>

scaled_matrix = scaler.fit_transform(selected_matrix)

# KMeans clustering
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
cluster_labels = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled_matrix)

# Create a DataFrame with the city-year rows and their cluster labels
city_clusters = pd.DataFrame({
    'city_id': selected_matrix['city_id'],
    'city_name': selected_matrix['city_name'],
    'year': selected_matrix['year'],
    'cluster_id': cluster_labels
})

# Write the city-cluster assignments to a CSV file
city_clusters.to_csv('outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv', index=False, quotechar='"')

# Compute the mean of the raw indicator values for each cluster
cluster_profiles = pd.DataFrame({
    'cluster_id': kmeans.labels_,
    'indicator1': [selected_matrix[selected_matrix['cluster_id'] == i]['indicator1'].mean() for i in range(3)],
    'indicator2': [selected_matrix[selected_matrix['cluster_id'] == i]['indicator2'].mean() for i in range(3)],
    'indicator3': [selected_matrix[selected_matrix['cluster_id'] == i]['indicator3'].mean() for i in range(3)]
})
